headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 14, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats. In other action, the New York Yankees took down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-1, with Paul Goldschmidt hitting his 9th home run of the season, and the San Diego Padres cruised past the Baltimore Orioles 9-3, with Randy Vásquez earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including José Ramírez, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. Other players on the injured list include Vinnie Pasquantino (Kansas City Royals), Evan Carter (Texas Rangers), Wilber Dotel (Pittsburgh Pirates), Jack Flaherty (Detroit Tigers), Miguel Andujar (San Diego Padres), Trent Grisham (New York Yankees), and Spencer Strider (Atlanta Braves).

The Chicago White Sox made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers also made a trade, acquiring RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera leading the charge at the plate. Herrera's impressive performance included two home runs and three RBIs in just three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Paul Goldschmidt leading the offense. Goldschmidt hit his 9th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored Cody Bellinger.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Randy Vásquez earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Samad Taylor led the Padres' offense with a 3-hit, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Nationals Cruise Past Mariners 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a decisive 8-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Cade Cavalli earning the win. Colt Emerson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **José Ramírez Sidelined with Left Hamate Fracture**
top_news.summary: Cleveland Guardians third baseman José Ramírez has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. The injury will keep him out of action for the time being.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
